headline: Crimson Desert Dev Conducting 'Extensive Research' on Multiplayer Modes, Plots Potential Sequels
summary: Pearl Abyss is exploring multiplayer modes for Crimson Desert. A Nintendo Switch 2 launch window is targeted. Potential sequels for the action RPG are being discussed.

headline: Intel Gamer Days Sale Offers Gaming PC Deals with Two Free Upcoming PC Games
summary: Intel Gamer Days Sale features top Walmart gaming PC deals. Purchases include two free, high-value PC games. These bonus games are worth $59.99 each at launch.

headline: House of the Dragon Showrunner Reveals His Iron Throne Choice
summary: Ryan Condal, showrunner, shares his pick for the Iron Throne. He believes his choice would bring Westeros stability. The revelation details which character is best suited to rule.

headline: CyberPowerPC Prebuilt Gaming PC with RTX 5070 for $1,399
summary: A CyberPowerPC prebuilt gaming PC is available for $1,399 shipped. It features a powerful GeForce RTX 5070 GPU. Comes with two free upcoming PC games: Star Wars Galactic Racer and Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis.

headline: Summer 2026 Set to Be UK's Hottest on Record
summary: The Met Office predicts Summer 2026 will be the UK's hottest on record. Only average temperatures are needed for the rest of August. This will surpass the record set just last year.

headline: Burnham 'Confident' Early Release of PC Harper's Killers Can Be Halted
summary: Burnham expresses confidence in halting the early release of PC Harper's killers. The Prime Minister states the justice secretary will present a plan. The plan in September aims to prevent further early releases.

headline: Eclipse Chasers Scramble for Glasses Amid Low Stocks
summary: Specialist eclipse glasses are nearly sold out online. Demand is high ahead of the UK's most significant eclipse since 1999. Enthusiasts are struggling to find protective eyewear.

headline: Watch: Was Trump Secretly Smuggled Off Air Force One?
summary: US media reports suggest Trump secretly exited Air Force One. He reportedly used a catering truck to avoid a perceived threat. The threat to his life was allegedly from Iran.
